Efa-e-Ahad iman ki alamat hai aur saff-e-ittihad ki alamat pehli ayat ki tafsir kayi baar guzar chuki hai ab phir is ka اعادہ (aada) karne ki zaroorat nahi. Phir un logon ka zikr hota hai jo kahen aur na karein, wada karein aur wafa na karein, ba'z ulama-e-salaf ne is ayat se istadlal kiya hai ki wada ka poora karna mutlaqan wajib hai jis se wada kiya hai khwah woh تاکید (takeed) kare ya na kare, un ki dalil Bukhari o Muslim ki yeh hadith bhi hai ki Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya munafiq ki teen aadatain hoti hain (1) jab wada kare khilaf kare (2) jab baat kare jhoot bole (3) jab amanat diya jaye khiyanat kare, dusri sahih hadith mein hai chaar baatein jis mein hon woh khalis munafiq hai aur jis mein in chaar mein se ek ho us mein ek khislat nifaq ki hai jab tak use na chhode. Un mein ek aadat wada khilafi ki hai, sharh-e-Sahih Bukhari ki ibtida mein hum ne in dono ahadith ki poori sharh kar di hai. Fa Alhamdulillah. Isi liye yahan bhi is ki takeed mein farmaya gaya Allah Ta'ala ko yeh baat sakht ناپسند (napasand) hai ki tum woh kaho jo khud na karo, Musnad Ahmad aur Abu Dawood mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Aamir bin Rabee'ah se riwayat hai ki hamare paas Rasool Allah ﷺ aaye main us waqt chhota bacha tha khel kood ke liye jaane laga toh meri walda ne mujhe aawaz de kar kaha idhar aa kuch dun An-Hazrat ﷺ ne farmaya kuch dena bhi chahti ho? Meri walda ne kaha haan Huzoor ﷺ khajoorein dunga (dungī) aap ne farmaya phir toh khair warna yaad rakho kuch na dene ka irada hota aur yun kahteeni toh tum par ek jhoot likha jata, Hazrat Imam Malik Rahimahullah farmate hain ki jab wade ke sath wada poora karne ki takeed ka talluq ho toh us wade ko wafa karna wajib ho jata hai, misalan kisi shakhs ne kisi se keh diya ki tu nikah karle aur itna itna har roz mein tujhe deta rahunga us ne nikah kar liya toh jab nikah baqi hai us shakhs par wajib hai ki use apne wade ke mutabiq deta rahe is liye ki is mein aadmi ke haq ka talluq sabit ho gaya jis par us se baaz purs sakhti ke sath ho sakti hai. Jamhoor ka mazhab yeh hai ki efa-e-ahad mutlaq wajib hi nahi, is ayat ka jawab woh yeh dete hain ki jab logon ne jihad ki farziyat ki khwahish ki aur farz ho gaya toh ab baaz log dekhne lage jis par yeh ayat utri, jaise aur jagah hai Al-Ayat, yaani kya tu ne unhein na dekha jin se kaha gaya tum apne haath ruke rakho aur namaz o zakat ka khayal rakho, phir jab un par jihad farz kiya gaya toh un mein aise log bhi nikal aaye jo logon se is tarah darne lage jaise Allah se darte hain balki us se bhi bahut zyada kehne lage parwardigar tu ne hum par jihad kyun farz kar diya? Kyun hamein ek waqt-e-muqarrar tak is hukm ko mukhar na kiya jo qareeb hi toh hai. Tu keh de ki asbab-e-duniya toh bahut hi kam hain haan parhizgaro ke liye akhirat behtareen cheez hai. Tum par kuch bhi zulm na kiya jaye ga tum kahen bhi ho tumhein maut dhoond nikalegi go tum mazboot mahalon mein ho, aur jagah hai Al-Ayat, yaani musalman kahte hain kyun koi surat nahi utari jati?

Phir jab koi muhhkama surat utari jati hai aur us mein larai ka zikr hota hai toh dekhega ke bimar dil wale teri taraf is tarah dekhenge jaise woh dekhta hai jis par maut ki behoshi ho, usi tarah ki yeh ayat bhi hai, Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain ke baaz momino ne jihad ki farziyat se pehle kaha ke kya hi acha hota Allah Ta'ala hamein woh amal batata jo use sabse zyada pasand hota taake hum us par amil hote pas Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi ﷺ ko khabar di ke sabse zyada pasandida amal mere nazdeek iman hai jo shak shubah se pak ho aur be-imano se jihad karna hai toh baaz musalmano par yeh giran guzra jis par Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayat utari ke woh baatein zuban se kyun nikalte ho jinhein karte nahi, Imam Ibn Jarir isi ko pasand farmate hain, Hazrat Muqatil bin Hayyan farmate hain ke musalmano ne kaha agar hamein maloom hojata ke kis amal ko Allah Ta'ala bahut pasand farmata hai toh hum zaroor woh amal baja late is par Allah Azzawajal ne woh amal bataya ke meri rah mein safein bandh kar mazbooti ke sath jam kar jihad karnewalo ko main bahut pasand farmata hun phir Uhud wale din un ki aazmaish ho gayi aur log peeth pher kar bhag khare hue jis par yeh farman-e-alishan utra ke kyun woh kehte ho jo ke nahi dikhate? Baaz hazrat farmate hain yeh un ke bare mein nazil hui hai jo kahein humne jihad kiya aur halanki jihad na kiya ho munh se kahein ke hum zakhmi hue aur zakhmi na hue hon kahein ke hum par mar pari aur mar na pari ho munh se kahein ke hum qaid kiye gaye aur qaid na kiye gaye hon, Ibn Zaid farmate hain is se murad munafiq hain ke musalmano ki madad ka wada karte lekin waqt par poora na karte, Zaid bin Aslam jihad murad lete hain, Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain in kehnewalo mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Rawahah Ansari R.A bhi the jab ayat utri aur maloom hua ke jihad sabse zyada amda amal hai toh aap ne ahd kar liya ke main toh ab se lekar marte dam tak Allah ki rah mein apne aap ko waqf kar chuka chunache usi par qayam bhi rahe yahan tak ke fi sabilillah shaheed ho gaye, Hazrat Abu Musa R.A ne Basra ke qariyon ko ek martaba bulwaya toh teen sau qari un ke paas aaye jin mein se har ek qari Quran tha. Phir farmaya tum ahl-e-Basra ke qari aur un mein se behtareen log ho suno hum ek surat parhte the jo musabbihat ki suratyon ke mushabeh thi phir hum use bhula diye gaye haan mujhe us mein se itna yaad reh gaya. (Ayat) Yani اے ایمان والو woh kyun kaho jo na karo phir woh likha jaye aur tumhari gardanon mein ba-taur gawah ke latka diya jaye phir qayamat ke din us ki babat baz-pursing ho.

Phir farmaya Allah Ta'ala ke mahbub woh log hain jo safein baandh kar dushmanan-e-Allah ke muqable mein dat jaate hain taake Allah ka bol bala ho, Islam ki hifazat ho aur deen ka ghalba ho. Musnad mein hai teen qism ke logon ki teen haalatein hain jinhein dekh kar Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala khush hota hai aur hans deta hai: raat ko uth kar tahajjud padhne wale, namaz ke liye safein baandhne wale, maidan-e-jang mein saf-bandi karne wale. 

Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai, Hazrat Mutarrif R.H farmate hain mujhe yeh riwayat Hazrat Abu Zar R.A ki ek hadith pahunchi thi, mere ji mein tha ki khud Hazrat Abu Zar R.A se mil kar yeh hadith aamne saamne sun loon. Chunacha ek martaba ja kar aap se mulaqat ki aur waqia bayan kiya, aap ne khushnudi ka izhar farma kar kaha woh hadith kya hai? Main ne kaha yeh ke Allah Ta'ala teen shakhson ko dushman jaanta hai aur teen ko dost rakhta hai. Farmaya haan, main ne apne Khalil Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ par jhoot nahi bola, fi-waqia aap ne hum se yeh hadith bayan farmaai hai. 

Main ne poocha woh teen kaun hain jinhein Allah Ta'ala mahbub jaanta hai? Farmaya ek toh woh jo Allah ki rah mein jihad kare, khalis khushnudi-e-Allah ki niyyat se nikle, dushman se jab muqabla ho toh dalirana jihad kare. Aap ki jaye paidaish Makkah hai, jaye hijrat Taaba (Madinah) hai, mulq aap ka Sham hai, ummat aap ki bakasrat hamd-e-Allah karne wali hai, har haal mein aur har manzil mein Allah Ta'ala ki hamd-o-sana bayan karte rehte hain.

Phir Hazrat Ka'ab ne usi ayat ki tilawat ki, phir farmaya: Suraj ki nigahbani karne wale jahan waqt-e-namaz aa jaye namaz ada kar lene wale, go sawari par hon.

Aur farman hai (Tarjuma) yaani yaqeenan Allah Ta'ala uski madad karega jo Allah ke deen ki madad kare beshak Allah Ta'ala badi quwwat wala aur ghair fani izrat wala hai, yeh madad aur yeh fateh duniya mein aur woh jannat aur nemat akhirat mein un logon ke hissa mein aayegi jo Allah Ta'ala ki aur uske Rasul ki itaat mein lage rahein aur deen-e-Allah ki khidmat mein jaan-o-maal se dareegh na karein isi liye farma diya ke A Nabi ﷺ in iman walon ko meri taraf se yeh khushkhabri pahuncha do.

Isa A.S ke 12 Sahaba ki Roodad: Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala apne momin bando ko hukum deta hai ki woh har aan aur har lahza jaan maal izzat abroo qaul feil naqal-o-harakat se dil aur zuban se Allah ki aur uske Rasool ki tamam tar baaton ki taamil mein rahein, phir misal deta hai ki Hazrat Isa ke tabedaaron ko dekho ki Hazrat Isa ki aawaz par foran labbaik pukar uthe aur unke is kehne par ki koi hai jo Allah ki baaton mein meri imdad kare unhone bila ghor al-faur keh diya ki hum sab aapke sathi hain aur Deen-e-Allah ki imdad mein aapke tabe hain, chunacha Ruhullah Alaihis Salam par Salawat-e-Allah ne Israeliyon aur Yunaniyon mein unhe muballigh bana kar Sham ke shahron mein bheja, Hajj ke dinon mein Sarwar-e-Rusal ﷺ bhi farmaya karte the ki koi hai jo mujhe jagah de taaki main Allah ki risalat ko pahuñcha doon Quraish to mujhe Rab ka paigham pahuñchane se rok rahe hain, chunacha Ahl-e-Madina ke qabile Aus-o-Khazraj ko Allah Ta'ala ne yeh saadat-e-abadi bakshi unhone aap se bait ki aap ki baatein qabool kiin, aur mazboot ahd-o-paiman kiye ki agar aap hamare haan aa jayein toh phir kisi surkh-o-siyah ki taaqat nahi jo aap ko dukh pahuñchaye hum aap ki taraf se jaanein lada dein ge aur aap par koi aanch na aane dein ge, phir jab Huzoor ﷺ apne sathiyon ko lekar hijrat kar ke unke haan gaye toh fi-waqia unhone apne kahe ko pura kar dikhaya aur apni zuban ki paasdari ki isi liye Ansar ke moazzaz laqab se mumtaz hue aur yeh laqab goya unka امتیازی (imtiyazi) naam ban gaya Allah unse khush ho aur unhe bhi raazi kare Aamin!

Jabkeh Hawariyon ko lekar Aap Deen-e-Allah ki tabligh ke liye khade hue toh Bani Israel ke kuch log toh rah-e-rast par aa gaye aur kuch log na aaye balki Aap ko aur Aap ki Walida-e-Majida Tahira ko badtareen burai ki taraf mansoub kiya, in Yahudiyon par Allah ki phatkar padi aur hamesha ke liye rand-e-dargah ban gaye, phir manne walon mein se bhi ek jam جماعت (jama'at) manne mein hi had se guzar gayi aur unhein unke darje se bahut badha diya, phir us groh mein bhi kai groh ho gaye, baaz toh kehne lage keh Syedna Hazrat Isa Alaihis Salam Allah ke bete hain, baaz ne kaha teen mein ke teesre hain yaani baap beta aur Ruh-ul-Qudus aur baaz ne toh Aap ko Allah hi maan liya, in sab ka zikr Surah An-Nisa mein mufassal mulahiza ho. 

Sachhe iman walon ki Janab-e-Bari ne apne Akhir-uz-Zaman Rasul ﷺ ki bisat se taeed ki, unke dushman Nasraniyon par unhein ghalib kar diya. Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.H farmate hain jab Allah ka irada hua keh Hazrat Isa ko aasman par chadha le, Aap naha-dho kar apne ashab ke paas aaye, sar se pani ke qatre tapak rahe the, yeh barah sahabah the jo ek ghar mein baithe hue the, aate hi farmaya: Tum mein woh bhi hain jo mujh par iman la chuke hain lekin phir mere sath kufr karenge aur ek do dafa nahi balki barah barah martaba. Phir farmaya: Tum mein se kaun is baat par amada hai ki is par meri mushabihat dali jaye aur woh mere badle qatal kiya jaye aur jannat mein mere darje mein mera sathi bane? 

Ek naujawan jo in sab mein kam umr tha, uth khada hua aur apne aap ko pesh kiya. Aap ne farmaya: Tum baith jao. Phir wahi baat kahi, ab ki martaba bhi kam umr naujawan sahabi R.A khade hue, Hazrat Isa ne ab ki martaba bhi unhein bitha diya. Phir teesri martaba yahi sawal kiya, ab ki martaba bhi yahi naujawan khade hue, Aap ne farmaya: Bahut behtar. Usi waqt unki shakl-o-surat bilkul Hazrat Isa jaisi ho gayi aur khud Hazrat Isa Alaihis Salam us ghar ke ek rozan se aasman ki taraf utha liye gaye. 

Ab Yahudiyon ki fauj aayi aur unhon ne us naujawan ko Hazrat Isa samajh kar giraftar kar liya aur qatal kar diya aur sولی par chadha diya aur Hazrat Isa ki peshin-goi ke mutabiq un baaqi ke gyarah logon mein se baaz ne barah barah martaba kufr kiya, halankeh woh is se pehle imandar the. Phir Bani Israel ke manne wale groh ke teen firqe ho gaye, ek firqe ne toh kaha keh khud Allah hamare darmiyan ba-surat-e-Masih tha, jab tak chaha raha phir aasman par chadha gaya, unhein Yaqubiyyah kaha jata hai; ek firqe ne kaha hum mein Allah ka beta tha jab tak Allah ne chaha use hum mein rakha aur jab chaha apni taraf chadha liya, unhein Saturiyyah kaha jata hai; teesri jamat haq par qayam rahi, unka aqeedah hai ke Allah ke bande aur Uske Rasul Hazrat Isa hum mein the, jab tak Allah ka irada raha Aap hum mein mojood rahe phir Allah Ta'ala ne apni taraf utha liya, yeh jamat Musalmanon ki hai.

Phir un dono kafir jama'aton ki taaqat barh gayi aur unhon ne un musalmanon ko maar peet kar qatl-o-gharat karna shuru kiya aur yeh dabay bhi huwey aur maghloob hi rahay yahan tak ke Allah Ta'ala ne apnay Nabi Hadrat Muhammad ﷺ ko mabouth farmaya, pas Bani Israel ki woh musalman jama'at Aap par bhi iman layi aur un kafir jama'aton ne Aap se bhi kufr kiya, un iman walon ki Allah Ta'ala ne madad ki aur unhein unkay dushmanon par ghalib kar diya, An-Hazrat ﷺ ka ghalib aa jana aur Deen-e-Islam ka tamam adiyan ko maghloob kar dena hi un ka ghalib aana aur apnay dushmanon par fateh pana hai. Mulahiza ho Tafsir Ibn Jarir aur Sunan Nasai. Pas yeh ummat haq par qayam reh kar hamesha tak ghalib rahegi yahan tak ke Amr-e-Ilahi ya'ni Qiyamat aa jaye aur yahan tak ke is ummat ke akhri log Hadrat Isa (A.S) ke sath ho kar Maseeh Dajjal se larai karenge jese ke sahih ahadees mein mojood hai. Wallahu A'lam. Allah Ta'ala ke fazl-o-karam se Surah As-Saff ki tafsir khatam hui, falhamdulillah.
